caseNameFull: W. R. Felker, etc. v. Southern Trust Company, as Trustee, etc.

opinions.text: October 11, *6341920.. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. Mr. Dick Rice for petitioners. Mr. G. B. Rose, Mr. W. E. Hemingway, Mr. D. H. Cantrell and Mr. J.'F. Loughborough for respondents.
